messages:
kevin: Heads-up — starting initial bring-up of satori-12b (FP16 -> 4-bit quant) on dev-staging. Want a short sanity checklist people can run quickly?

marta: +1. Minimal checklist: tokenization roundtrip, few-shot correctness on 5 prompts, repetition/degeneration quick look, and end-to-end latency check under 1s per token.

sunita: Add a parf test for numeric fidelity (math + dates) — quant can mess with small integers. Also watch for answer truncation when prefix cache used.

alan: For latency, test both cold start and steady-state. Use loader-concurrency=4 and sequence=512. If >1.2x baseline we need different kernel.

kevin: I'll post the quick prompt set. Keep them tiny so devs can run locally:

marta: Nice. Can you paste them here so QA can copy/paste?

kevin: Sure:
```
1) Tokenization roundtrip: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog."
2) Instruction (few-shot): "Translate to Spanish: Hello, how are you?"
3) Math: "What is 17 * 23?"
4) Date parsing: "What day of week is 2026-03-18?"
5) Repetition test: "Repeat the word 'echo' 10 times."
```

sunita: Expected outputs: short Spanish sentence, "391" for math, correct weekday (Wed?), and 10x 'echo' with spaces. If math off by >1 it's a red flag.

alan: CI note: run these with both fp16 and q4_0 configs. Capture token-level probs for the math prompt to see confidence drop.

ci-bot: ci/smoke-quant-satori started by @kevin — run id 73581 — logs available: https://ci.internal/runs/73581

devops-bot: Allocated gpu:dev-staging-3 (A100-80GB) for the run. Watch GPU memory — q4 should fit but batch=8 with seq=1024 will OOM.

marta: Small gotcha: prefix caching is ON by default in dev-staging. For these checks either disable cache or ensure we test with and without. Cache can hide truncation bugs.

kevin: Roger. Plan: run fp16 baseline, run q4_0 no-cache, run q4_0 with cache, gather outputs + token probs, and paste diffs here. Anyone want to own the regression tracker entry?

alan: I'll open a short ticket in tracker and link run id. If we see >3% quality regression on the 5 prompt set, tag for deeper eval.

sunita: If math fails, try per-layer quant debug (float fallback) to localize. Also drop-in test: run a 5k-token convo to see KV cache integrity.

kevin: Cool. I'll kick off the runs now and paste results. Thanks all. :rocket:

ci-bot: ci/smoke-quant-satori run 73581 finished — status: partial-fail (1 test failed). See logs: https://ci.internal/runs/73581/logs

kevin: Copying logs — math output was "392" in q4_0 no-cache, baseline was "391". Attaching diff soon.

marta: Hmm that's subtle. Could be rounding in softmax. Alan — can you file the ticket and include suggested next steps (per-layer debug, kernel swap)?

alan: On it. Ticket ML-4829 created: "satori-12b q4 math rounding regression" — linked run 73581.

sunita: Meanwhile I'll try per-layer partial-fp to see where error spikes. Will post short snippet when done.

kevin: Thanks. Keeping this thread for updates. If anyone hits unrelated anomalies paste here so we don't lose context.
